documents.title: Refill request: nitroglycerin SL
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Mail-order pharmacy requesting renewal of nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL tabs #25, original Rx from cardiology 7/2024. Pt messaged that the bottle has been open since summer and cardiology told him to replace it every few months once opened. Last PCP visit 10/23/24.
Routed to PCP.

PCP: Sent nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL #25, same sig (sit down; repeat q5min up to 3; 911 if not better after first; not within 24 h of sildenafil), 2 refills. Cardiology remains prescriber of record.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: DM/HTN/angina f/u
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Spring check-in. Angina unchanged since fall - occasional with stairs, nitro works, sits when he takes it. No rest pain. Weight 86.9 kg, a little up over the winter. Following meal plan "most of the time." Feet numb, no wounds; inspects daily.

Vitals: BP 130/76, HR 73.
Exam: regular rhythm, no murmur; lungs clear; no edema. Feet - dry skin, metatarsal calluses, no ulcer; monofilament reduced; pedal pulses diminished.

Plan: A1c and BMP. Continue metformin 1000 BID, amlodipine 5, atorvastatin 20, aspirin 81, NTG prn, sildenafil prn. Eye exam due June. Annual labs in the fall. RTC 6 mo.

Addendum 4/10: A1c 7.1%, creatinine normal.

documents.title: Results
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Hi Gary, A1c 7.1% and kidney tests normal. PCP says no changes. Have a good spring!

documents.body:

documents.title: Flu + COVID
documents.author: RN
documents.body: 2025-26 flu (trivalent) L deltoid and 2025-26 COVID (Pfizer) R deltoid. VIS reviewed. No prior reactions. Observed, tolerated well.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Feels well. Angina pattern the same as the past year, stairs only, settles with rest or one nitro. No emergency visits, no rest pain. Flu/COVID 10/1. Taking everything as prescribed. No hypoglycemia. Feet numb, no sores.

O: BP 128/78 HR 66 SpO2 97% Wt 87.4 kg
CV regular. Lungs clear. Ext without edema. Diabetic foot exam: intact skin, calluses, LOPS bilaterally, pulses diminished.

A/P:
T2DM w/ CKD 1 + neuropathy - A1c, CMP, UACR, CBC today. Lipid panel at the January visit.
HTN - amlodipine 5.
Stable angina, PAD - unchanged; aspirin, statin, NTG prn.
RTC January (fasting).

documents.title: Lab results 10/22
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Gary - A1c 7.0%. Kidney filtration normal (eGFR 97), urine albumin 47, same as prior years. Liver tests and blood count normal. Please come fasting in January so we can do the cholesterol panel.

documents.title: Renewals for 2026
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Mail order requests renewals: metformin 1000 mg #180, amlodipine 5 mg #90, atorvastatin 20 mg #90. Pended. PCP approved x 3 refills. Pt has January visit booked.
